connector.name: Zeroheight
connector.registryDescription: Connect AI assistants to zeroheight styleguides using the Model Context Protocol
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.zeroheight.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.zeroheight, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: ZEROHEIGHT_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Optional zeroheight access token (starts with zhat_). If omitted, the local MCP uses OAuth.

env.name: ZEROHEIGHT_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Optional zeroheight client ID (starts with zhci_). If omitted, the local MCP uses OAuth.
